info.cls_ename: Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 應用力學是描述及預測力作用於剛體的現象或結果，分為靜力學與動力學。應用力學(一)為靜力學，是分析剛體受外力作用時能達到力平衡而維持靜止的條件。本課程為材料(彈性體)力學的預備課程，並為設計承載結構等工程應用之基礎。
description.describe_eh: Applied Mechanics is a physical science which describes and predicts the results of rigid bodies under action of forces. It is divided into statics and dynamics. Applied Mechanics (1) deals with statics which analyzes the conditions of equilibrium or rest of rigid bodies under action of forces. This course is a pre-work of mechanics of deformable bodies, and provides as a foundation in structural engineering design. Engineering Mechanics is that physical science which deals with the state of rest or motion of bodies under the action of forces.  It plays the greatest role in engineering analysis and is an absolute prerequisite for work in most engineering fields.
